title: Payments deployment parameters
description: Provide the parameters for the payments service production deployment.

change_ticket.title: Change ticket
change_ticket.description: The change ticket number authorizing this deployment. Format is shaped, not validated.

maintenance_start.title: Maintenance window start
maintenance_start.description: Start of the maintenance window during which the deployment is permitted. Must be a real calendar date; the mask shapes only (mm/dd/yyyy).

on_call_contact.title: On-call contact
on_call_contact.description: Phone number of the on-call engineer for this deployment.
